name: memory
title: Long-term memory (pgvector)
description: Semantic long-term memory for an eve agent, stored in your own Postgres with pgvector. No vector service, no extra container, no bill.
docs: Requires a Postgres with the pgvector extension available (the pgvector/pgvector image has it) and WORKFLOW_POSTGRES_URL set. The tools import lib/memory.ts by relative path, so no `imports` or tsconfig `paths` entry is needed — but if your tsconfig `include` lists only agent/, add "lib/**/*.ts" so the file is typechecked. Uses HNSW indexing, which is correct on an empty table — IVFFlat is not. `forget` is gated with approval: always(), so deleting a memory always parks the turn for a human decision — it is also the worked example of human-in-the-loop.
